title: Ruinous Manipulations
subtitle: Mortem — blood remembers death
text: Ruinous blood has witnessed too much dying. Vital Reservoir (QUICK, 50): siphon death-adjacent energy from nearby decay and store it as a temporary buffer in the blood. Hemorrhage (QUICK, 75): tear open a target's vessels, inflicting deep blood-loss over several seconds. Exsanguinate (QUICK, 300): forcibly draw blood from a target outward — the most violent of the common manipulations.
